senses.gloss:
कुन्तयः

- देशः। भीo 9। 40।। { Ancient town of Malwa, the birth place of Kunti. It was situyated on the bank of a small river called Aswanadi. }

कुन्तलाः

- देशः। भीo 9। 52।। { The ancient name of the Province in which Kurugode is situated. A portion of the Bellary District in the Madras Presidency. }
